title: Does Pinnacle Blooms Network provide regular updates on my child's progress in therapy?
metaTitle: Regular Progress Updates - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Stay informed on your child's therapy journey with regular progress updates from us at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: Absolutely. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we deeply value parents' involvement in their child's therapeutic journey. We believe that you, as parents, are irreplaceable members of your child's treatment team. Therefore, we stress a transparent and consistent communication strategy where we provide regular updates on your child's progress. Pre-assessment, periodic assessments, therapy snapshots - every tiny step forward is shared with you. These updates give you insights into your child's improvements, allowing you to understand how therapy is benefits your child, and how you can support your child's development and learning even outside the therapy space.
